title: Coordinates for local recovery of etale module presentations
statement: For a scheme $T$ [def-pc-scheme] and its Zariski and small etale ringed sites [lem-trf-zariski-etale-tensor-sections], define restriction to an etale chart $U$ by pushforward along the localization equivalence with the identity ring map. Define the free comparison as the adjoint of the free generator sections. For two equal structure maps define the identity-underlying-scheme isomorphism. Given a quasi-coherent $F$ [pqf-def-coherent], a tensor comparison and $b:L_U F\simeq G|_U$, define the local section map on a test overlap by tensor-pullback composition, then the inverse tensor comparison, then $b$, and finally the equality transport. The canonical overlap comparison of pullbacks of one global module is the composite of its two tensor-composition isomorphisms [def-pc-module-pullback]. These are the existing five coordinate definitions formerly in the effective recovery module, unchanged.

mathlib_searches.query: A quasicoherent module on the small etale site is recovered by restriction to the Zariski site and effective descent of free presentations
mathlib_searches.verdict: Local presentations alone do not construct compatible Zariski cokernels or their descent.
The Hom equivalence and triangle identities supply the final formal argument; not the local recovery or descent.
